thread:
Jordan: Quick kickoff — we need to align on the initial marketplace bundle for AWS/GCP/Azure. I uploaded a draft package to the drive and sketched the legal options. High level asks: publisher account IDs, final logos (SVG + 2x PNG), which EULA variant, AMI vs container image choice, and an estimated go-live date.

Sara: @jordan got it. can you paste the minimal manifest snippet here? helps to validate fields with engineering and cloud ops.

Jordan: sure — minimal example below:```yaml
product_name: redwood-inference
sku: RWI-CORE-001
images:
  - type: ami
    region: us-west-2
    id: ami-0abcd1234efgh5678
pricing_model: subscription
trial: 14d
```

Kevin: AMI is ok for AWS but for GCP we'll need a container image. recommend we publish both artifacts and mark the primary for each cloud. @mike can infra ops confirm container registries we can use?

Mike: @kevin yes — use gcr.io/redwood-inference for GCP, and ghcr.io/redwood-inference for Azure container artifacts. I'll share creds in the secure channel. :lock:

Priya: legal question — which EULA variants are in play? variant A is lightweight dev-friendly, variant B has enterprise indemnities. we should pick B if we want sales to push pedigreed enterprise customers.

legal-bot: Legal: recommend EULA-B for marketplace listings requiring SLA/enterprise support. If we go EULA-A we need to add a supplemental terms doc for Dedicated/Private.

Jordan: thanks. decision: go with EULA-B for initial listings. Sara, can you drive the branding pack (SVG + 2x PNG + 1:1 thumbnail) and drop in the drive by Wednesday? Kevin/Mike: please confirm artifact URIs and a short deploy checklist by EOD Friday.

Sara: on it — I'll also include a short README with the usage screenshots and 1-line product description for the marketplace tile.

Kevin: infra checklist draft: 1) validate AMI/container image in staging 2) verify marketplace entitlement mapping 3) set trial period metadata 4) smoke test sign-up flow 5) edge-case rollback plan. I'll post a short PR with the checklist.

Jordan: perfect. I'll coordinate with Partnerships PM for co-marketing blurb and partner SLAs. tagging follow-ups: @sara (branding), @kevin (infra checklist), @mike (registry creds), @priya (legal handoff).

Priya: noted — I'll prepare the EULA-B summary + required legal artifact list. expect a doc in drive by Thursday morning.

Mike: creds posted to secure channel, shared with the team. :thumbsup:

Jordan: great work team — plan to reconvene Thursday 11:00 PT to confirm assets and finalize listing windows.

Sara: calendar invite sent. :calendar:

Kevin: +1

Priya: +1

Jordan: closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear.
